record_title: Lambert-W large-distortion law for the harmonic Schwarz extremal
provenance: Large-distortion asymptotic refinement of the centered pointwise-distortion extremal characterized in Knežević--Mateljević, arXiv:2609.19609v1.
limitations: Only the centered unit-ball pointwise-distortion extremal family is covered; no global quasiconformality is asserted. The Lambert-W formula is asymptotic rather than an exact solution of the full elliptic optimizer equation. Wegmann's 1993 full text, the closest older source for the ellipse Fourier coefficients, was not independently inspected and remains a residual originality risk. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.

artifact_inventory.description: Deterministic high-precision check of the exact elliptic optimizer equation against the Lambert-W, deficit, and boundary asymptotics.
